executive_summary: Overall performance for the period shows a total spend of 2,742.04 with a healthy average CTR of 3.87%, indicating strong creative resonance. However, the cost efficiency is under pressure with a high CPM of 363.62 and an average cost per message of approximately 91.40. While engagement is high, the conversion into messages is volatile across different campaign objectives.

best_campaigns.name: 📁 2026 | Leads | Multi Models | JULY
best_campaigns.reason: Achieved the lowest cost per message in the current set (41.28 on peak days) and maintains a strong CTR above 4.5%.

best_campaigns.name: JULY ADS 2026
best_campaigns.reason: Highest overall engagement and best CTR (5.23%), showing strong top-of-funnel interest despite volatile messaging costs.

worst_campaigns.name: 📁 2026 | Sales | Multi Models | July
worst_campaigns.reason: Highest cost per message (up to 123.54) and inconsistent message generation compared to the Leads objective.

winning_ads.insight: The specific monthly payment hook (₱15K+) is driving the highest click-through rate and most efficient lead cost.
High volume of link clicks and page engagement, indicating strong aspirational interest in the Xpander model.

creative_insights.performance: Top performer. Monthly amortization hooks (₱15K+) outperform generic 'Low DP' messaging.
Historically the backbone of the account but currently underperforming in the July Sales campaign; requires updated 'Business Promo' visuals.
Client release videos show high engagement but were largely paused; these should be utilized for social proof to lower CPM.

historical_insights.detail: Current cost per message (90+) is significantly higher than Q1 2026 levels where L300 sales campaigns achieved 16.84 - 17.13 per message.
CPM has ballooned from historical averages of 28.00 - 100.00 to the current 363.62, suggesting high audience saturation or increased competition in the target locations.

recommendations.suggestion: Shift budget from '📁 2026 | Sales | Multi Models | July' to the 'Leads' objective campaign which is delivering 55% cheaper inquiries.
Pause the 'JULY ADS 2026' on days where cost per message exceeds 150.00. Implement automated rules to manage this volatility.
The high CPM (363.62) suggests audience fatigue. Test Lookalike Audiences (LLA) based on previous message senders, as historical LLA sets (from 2024 data) were highly effective.
Develop new 'Business/Utility' focused creatives for the L300. Use the winning 'Monthly Amortization' template from the Mirage G4 and apply it to the Xpander and L300 models.
